name: meadow
description: Language support for Meadow: syntax highlighting, diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, rename, inlay hints, a test runner and a debugger.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode the language server does not fetch a package's dependencies, which would clone the repositories its manifest names and run their macros. It uses only what `meadow build` already fetched.

meadow.server.path.description: Path to the `meadow` executable; the extension runs `meadow lsp`. Left at `meadow`, it searches your PATH first, then $MEADOW_HOME/bin, ~/.cargo/bin and ~/.meadow/bin — an editor launched from the Dock or the Start menu does not inherit your shell PATH. Whatever it finds is asked whether it understands `lsp` before being used.

meadow.debug.codeLens.description: Show a "Debug" link above each top-level definition, which asks for its arguments and starts the debugger there.

meadow.test.codeLens.description: Show a "Test" link above each `@test`, which runs that one test with `meadow test --exact`.

meadow.inlayHints.enabled.description: Show inferred types after parameters and `let` bindings.

meadow.trace.server.description: Log the traffic between VS Code and the language server.

test.description: The qualified name of the test to run: `Module.test`, or the bare name in the root module.

program.description: What to debug: a package directory (one with a Meadow.toml) or a single .mw file.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop before the first line of `main` runs.

entry.description: Start at an expression instead of `main` -- what the "Debug" link above a definition fills in.

module.description: The .mw file the expression is written in; it sees what that module sees.

function.description: Stop as soon as this top-level definition of `module` is entered.

configurationSnippets.label: Meadow: Launch
configurationSnippets.description: Debug a Meadow package or file.
